method: AI-assisted evidence review against the frozen development ground truth. Failed executions receive no quality score.

cases.finding: GLM clearly explains character traversal, the early False return, and the final is_end_of_word check.
GLM preserves the password-to-national-id lookup, patient lookup, phone comparison, and both False paths.
GLM correctly describes the user-object result, password failure, and both caught lookup exceptions.
GLM covers book lookup, active review ordering, conditional form creation, and template rendering.
GLM reached the unchanged 1200-token limit; no quality score was assigned.
GLM accurately explains plain text, valid fences, malformed-fence errors, and extraction of inner lines.

glm_failure.interpretation: The provider returned normally, but model reasoning consumed most of the unchanged completion budget and left truncated visible JSON. This is not an adapter or connectivity failure.

conclusion.primary: The large quality gain on five identical inputs shows that weak Persian rendering is primarily a Qwen 3B model limitation, not a general limitation of deterministic Documentation facts and citation composition.
conclusion.limitation: GLM is not yet production-reliable under the unchanged 1200-token contract because one of six cases truncated.
